name: service-quotas
description: With Service Quotas, you can view and manage your quotas easily as your Amazon Web Services workloads grow.

subcommands.name: associate-service-quota-template
subcommands.description: Associates your quota request template with your organization.

subcommands.name: create-support-case
subcommands.description: Creates a Support case for an existing quota increase request.

subcommands.name: delete-service-quota-increase-request-from-template
subcommands.description: Deletes the quota increase request for the specified quota from your quota request template.

subcommands.name: disassociate-service-quota-template
subcommands.description: Disables your quota request template.

subcommands.name: get-association-for-service-quota-template
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of the association for the quota request template.

subcommands.name: get-auto-management-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about your Service Quotas Automatic Management configuration.

subcommands.name: get-aws-default-service-quota
subcommands.description: Retrieves the default value for the specified quota.

subcommands.name: get-quota-utilization-report
subcommands.description: Retrieves the quota utilization report for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-requested-service-quota-change
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified quota increase request.

subcommands.name: get-service-quota
subcommands.description: Retrieves the applied quota value for the specified account-level or resource-level quota.

subcommands.name: get-service-quota-increase-request-from-template
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified quota increase request in your quota request template.

subcommands.name: list-aws-default-service-quotas
subcommands.description: Lists the default values for the quotas for the specified Amazon Web Services service.

subcommands.name: list-requested-service-quota-change-history
subcommands.description: Retrieves the quota increase requests for the specified Amazon Web Services service.

subcommands.name: list-requested-service-quota-change-history-by-quota
subcommands.description: Retrieves the quota increase requests for the specified quota.

subcommands.name: list-service-quota-increase-requests-in-template
subcommands.description: Lists the quota increase requests in the specified quota request template.

subcommands.name: list-service-quotas
subcommands.description: Lists the applied quota values for the specified Amazon Web Services service.

subcommands.name: list-services
subcommands.description: Lists the names and codes for the Amazon Web Services services integrated with Service Quotas.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags assigned to the specified applied quota.

subcommands.name: put-service-quota-increase-request-into-template
subcommands.description: Adds a quota increase request to your quota request template.

subcommands.name: request-service-quota-increase
subcommands.description: Submits a quota increase request for the specified quota at the account or resource level.

subcommands.name: start-auto-management
subcommands.description: Starts Service Quotas Automatic Management for an Amazon Web Services account, including notification preferences and excluded quotas configurations.

subcommands.name: start-quota-utilization-report
subcommands.description: Initiates the generation of a quota utilization report for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: stop-auto-management
subcommands.description: Stops Service Quotas Automatic Management for an Amazon Web Services account and removes all associated configurations.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to the specified applied quota.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified applied quota.

subcommands.name: update-auto-management
subcommands.description: Updates your Service Quotas Automatic Management configuration, including notification preferences and excluded quotas.
